title: Each rejected frame climbs the picture ladder on its own, sharing one bound on looks and drawings, with every look asked and paid once and no photo twice on a page
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A frame whose looks come back at once climbs its whole ladder (three looks, two rungs) before the slow first look of another frame comes back.
Two frames of one page that are rejected at the same moment and climb at once never show the same owner photo, and the duplicate rule P06 passes.
With several frames climbing and looking ahead, the provider answers exactly one look per non-cached record, and the save pays each look once.
One look asked twice at the same time, plus a look-ahead of it, is one provider call and one paid record.
A frame climbing alone takes the same rungs, photos and verdicts with one look at a time as with random look latencies.
A gallery tile with no new photo reuses a photo of its page and never takes its neighbour's photo.

tests: a slow look of one frame does not hold back the next rung of another
two frames of one page that climb at once never show the same photo
with frames climbing at once and looking ahead, every look is asked once and paid once
two asks of one look at the same time are one look: asked once, paid once, recorded once as paid
a frame climbing alone takes the same rungs, photos and verdicts however long each look takes
a gallery tile no new photo fits reuses a photo of its page, cut elsewhere, never next to its other tile
